{{Quote|Talon Leader to Talon Eight, any change?''"<br />"''No, sir. He's not broadcasting. As far as I can tell, he's not homing in on any sort of a signal. And I'm still not picking up any engine emissions, other than his or ours, on the scanners."|Myn Donos and "Talon Eight" discussing a lone TIE Interceptor|<ref name="WS" />}}
"'''Talon Eight'''" was the [[Callsign/Legends|call sign]] of a [[Gender/Legends|male]] [[Pilot/Legends|pilot]] who flew an [[X-wing starfighter/Legends|X-wing starfighter]] for the [[New Republic/Legends|New Republic]] [[New Republic Starfighter Command|Starfighter Command]] as part of [[Talon Squadron (New Republic)|Talon Squadron]]. "Talon Eight" served as the communications specialist for the squadron.<ref name="WS" />

During a simple mission of following a lone [[TIE/IN interceptor/Legends|TIE Interceptor]] on a New Republic controlled system, Talon Squadron was [[Ambush at Gravan Seven|ambushed]] at the [[Planet/Legends|planet]] [[Gravan Seven]] by numerically superior forces belonging to [[Warlord/Legends|Warlord]] [[Zsinj]]. Talon Eight was [[Death/Legends|killed]] by the initial volley of lasers.<ref name="WS" />
